clue.text: Step behind Somerset's opener — to put him off?

indicators.note: behind says the step comes after, so the county's first letter is placed in front of it

parts.note: the first letter of Somerset
a ledge is a step or shelf

explanation.surface: A cricketer steps behind Somerset's opening batsman, perhaps to distract him.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, to sledge is to taunt a batsman verbally to break his concentration; Somerset is an English county side.
explanation.definitionFit: Sledging is the cricket practice of needling a batsman with insults so that his concentration fails.

clue.text: Croon On the Wings of Love unaccompanied

indicators.note: on means placed after in a down clue, so one piece sits below the other

parts.note: to croon is to sing softly

indicators.note: the wings of a building are its two ends, so only the outside letters are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A crooner sings the song On the Wings of Love without a band.
explanation.walkthrough: On the Wings of Love is a Jeffrey Osborne song, but here the title splits into a placing word and a selection.
explanation.definitionFit: Single means alone, on one's own, without anyone accompanying.

clue.text: Hemmed in and losing head, uncle cried out

indicators.note: out here means wild and disordered, so the letters are jumbled
to lose your head is to lose the top, so the first letter goes

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A relative, trapped and losing his head, shouted out.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemmed in means surrounded on all sides, which is exactly what being ringed round means.

clue.text: A lot of chocs and gin after stirring pasta

indicators.note: stirring mixes things up, so the letters are mixed into a new order
a lot but not all, so the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: short for chocolates
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dessert recipe: stir most of the chocolates and some gin into pasta.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnocchi are small Italian dumplings made from potato or semolina and classed as a kind of pasta.

clue.text: Handle online customer with reputation

parts.note: a user is a customer of a service
as in making a name for yourself

explanation.surface: Advice on dealing with an internet shopper who has a reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: A handle is slang for the identifying name someone uses on the internet, which is a login name.

clue.text: When there's not much going on goose, add salt?

definitions.text: When there's not much going on

parts.note: a goose is a silly person, as in you silly
to season food is to add salt to it

explanation.surface: A cook in a quiet spell idly wonders about salting a goose.
explanation.walkthrough: Goose looks like the bird for roasting, but it means a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: The silly season is the summer lull when newspapers fill space with trivial stories for lack of real news.

clue.text: Go back on essential part of Scream plot

indicators.note: the essential part is the heart, so the centre letters of the word are kept

parts.note: the central two letters of the word
a plot of land is a tract

explanation.surface: A film studio backing out of the key part of the Scream storyline.
explanation.walkthrough: Plot suggests a film story, but it is an area of land.
explanation.definitionFit: To go back on a statement or promise is to withdraw it, the meaning of this verb.

clue.text: Juliet avoiding pleasure trips for relatives

indicators.note: to avoid something is to stay clear of it, so that letter is left out

parts.note: jaunts are short trips for fun
Juliet is J in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Juliet skips the family outings with her relations.
explanation.definitionFit: Aunts are relatives, the sisters of a parent.

clue.text: Switch conversation

definitions.meaning: first meaning: swap one thing for another

explanation.walkthrough: Switch might suggest a telephone switchboard, which also links to the word, but the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for swapping and a noun for a back-and-forth of words between people.

clue.text: Chips in very hot container overturned

indicators.note: something overturned is upside down, so in a down-reading sense the string is read the other way round

parts.note: so means very, as in so hot
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
a can is a container

explanation.surface: Fried chips sitting in a scalding pot that has been knocked over.
explanation.definitionFit: Nachos are tortilla chips, typically served with melted cheese and salsa.

clue.text: Spiritual, Clapton converts and embraces India

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold in your arms, so one piece goes around the other
to convert is to change form, so the guitarist's name is rearranged

parts.note: the guitarist's name taken as written
India is I in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Eric Clapton turns to Eastern spirituality and takes up India.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged name is split so the I goes in near the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Platonic love is spiritual rather than physical, a sense loosely derived from Plato's ideas.

clue.text: How emotional librettists express themselves?

parts.note: surface reading: the manner in which opera writers who are moved speak
setter's reading: librettists write the words to be sung, so they express themselves in song words, which also means effusively

explanation.surface: A question about how passionate opera wordsmiths put their feelings across.
explanation.walkthrough: The adverb means both with lyrics and in an effusive, heartfelt way, and librettists suit both.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking in an effusive, poetic, heartfelt manner is a standard figurative sense of the adverb.

clue.text: Bass power, a feature of Weather Report?

parts.note: bass notes are low ones
pressure is force or power

explanation.surface: Weather Report, the jazz-fusion band, famed for its powerful bass playing.
explanation.walkthrough: Weather Report was a jazz group with celebrated bassists; the definition is really a weather forecast.
explanation.definitionFit: Areas of low atmospheric pressure, bringing rain and wind, are a regular item in forecasts.

clue.text: On the drink, disoriented

definitions.meaning: first meaning: on the ocean, the drink being slang for the sea

explanation.surface: Someone who is drunk and lost their bearings.
explanation.walkthrough: On the drink looks like boozing, but the drink is slang for the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means out on the ocean, and idiomatically means confused or lost.

clue.text: Very tired girls went to play sport

parts.note: all in is an idiom for exhausted

indicators.note: letters sent to play are let loose to frolic, so they move into a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Some exhausted girls went off to play a game.
explanation.definitionFit: All-in wrestling is a freestyle form of the sport with few restrictions on holds.

clue.text: Dull prisoner welcomes one in-law occasionally turning up

indicators.note: to welcome is to take someone in, so the prisoner wraps around the rest

parts.note: an inmate is a prisoner

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue flips the order so the letters read upwards
occasionally means now and then, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: the second and fourth letters
the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A dull convict greets an in-law who visits now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Inanimate means lifeless or lacking spirit, hence dull.

clue.text: Perhaps kings my French son holds in bridge

indicators.note: to hold something in is to keep it within, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: French for my
S is the abbreviation for son
an arch is a bridge-like structure

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's son keeping kings in hand at the card game bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: Bridge suggests the card game, where kings are cards; it is an arch.
explanation.definitionFit: Kings are examples of monarchs, sovereign rulers, as the word Perhaps signals.

clue.text: Routine article on source of coal tar

indicators.note: on here means placed after, so the article follows the coal source

parts.note: routine means everyday, commonplace
a seam is a layer of coal in the ground
the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A dull piece on where coal tar comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: Coal tar looks like one substance, but the definition is just tar, slang for a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A tar is a sailor, and an ordinary seaman is the most junior rank of naval sailor.

clue.text: No charge for such a small thing

definitions.text: No charge for such a small thing

parts.words: No charge for such a small thing
parts.note: surface reading: a trifle is free, as a shop might say
setter's reading: a tiny particle with zero electric charge

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper waives payment for a trivial item.
explanation.walkthrough: Charge means price on the surface but electric charge in physics.
explanation.definitionFit: The particle in an atomic nucleus that carries no electric charge, alongside the proton.

clue.text: Shellfish caught by Ahab, a loner

indicators.note: caught by means held inside, so the letters sit within the words that follow

parts.note: runs across the three words

explanation.surface: A sea creature landed by Captain Ahab, the solitary whaler of Moby-Dick.
explanation.definitionFit: Abalone is an edible sea snail with an ear-shaped shell lined with mother-of-pearl.

clue.text: Time in advance to get stationery item

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: to advance an idea is to put it forward
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Allow time beforehand to pick up office supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: In advance looks like beforehand, but in is the placing word and advance a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A Post-it is a small sticky note pad, a familiar office supply.

clue.text: Chasing promotion, wise guy oddly ignored for so long

indicators.note: what chases comes behind, so these letters follow the promotion

parts.note: an ad promotes a product

indicators.note: ignoring the odd-numbered positions leaves only the second, fourth and so on

parts.note: the even letters of the phrase

explanation.surface: A smart alec chasing a promotion who gets ignored for a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is a French farewell, used in English the way people say goodbye or so long.

clue.text: Possibly 4 meals M&S put out — perfect

indicators.note: to put out is to eject, so those two letters are thrown out

parts.note: 4 across is a login handle, and an ID is one such
taken as written
the letters removed

explanation.surface: Marks & Spencer ready meals marketed as flawless.
explanation.walkthrough: M&S is the British retailer Marks & Spencer, known for ready meals; here it is just two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal as an adjective means perfect, matching an imagined standard of excellence.

clue.text: Romans in a new land

indicators.note: something new is made afresh, so the letters are formed into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Ancient Romans settling in a newly found territory.
explanation.definitionFit: San Marino is a tiny independent republic surrounded by Italy, so it is a country.

clue.text: Applauds winning rallies

parts.note: to cheer is to applaud
a team ahead is up

explanation.surface: A crowd applauds the winning shots in a long tennis exchange.
explanation.walkthrough: Rallies looks like a noun from tennis; it is the verb, meaning recovers in spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: To rally is to recover spirits or revive, the same as becoming happier again.

clue.text: Forty per cent of Simpson & Son's capital

parts.note: Homer Simpson, the cartoon father; two of his five letters
Bart is Homer Simpson's son

explanation.surface: Like a firm's books, a share of the money belonging to a family business.
explanation.walkthrough: Simpson & Son reads like a company name, but it is cartoon father and son from The Simpsons.
explanation.definitionFit: Hobart is the capital city of Tasmania, the Australian island state.

clue.text: Stay with South American novelist

parts.note: the abbreviation for South America
to linger is to stay on

explanation.surface: An invitation to stay on with a Latin American writer.
explanation.definitionFit: J. D. Salinger was the American author of The Catcher in the Rye.

clue.text: Abandon Antarctica?

definitions.meaning: second meaning: an arid region, which the frozen continent technically is

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that Antarctica is an example: with so little precipitation it counts as the world's largest dry wasteland.
explanation.definitionFit: Antarctica gets so little precipitation that geographers classify it as the largest arid region on Earth.
